'''2000 Florida State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Florida in spring 2000. [[Walter Cowart]] won it with a Light Throne Room mains deck.<ref name="dt-5008">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/5008 Florida State Champs LS], DeckTech (Walter "Walter" Cowart, 2 April 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/5008/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/5008/ GitHub Pages].</ref> [[Gabriel Alonso]] posted the Throne Room mains deck he played there, which went 2–1.<ref name="dt-5920">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/5920 FL States - Throne Room Mains ( No-Revo)], DeckTech (Gabriel "The Diplomat" Alonso, 24 April 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/5920/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/5920/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 2000 (before 2 April)
* '''Site:''' Florida
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Walter Cowart]]

== Decklists ==
Players posted these lists on DeckTech as decks they played at the event; the posted list may differ slightly from the one played.

* [[2000 Florida State Championship Gabriel Alonso FL States - Throne Room Mains ( No-Revo)]] ([[Gabriel Alonso]], [[Light]]; 2–1) — "This is the deck I used at states. It went 2-1 Losing to Raltiir Ops"
* [[2000 Florida State Championship Walter Cowart Florida State Champs LS]] ([[Walter Cowart]], [[Light]]; 1st) — "a Throne Room mains deck thatI used to win the Florida State Championsihp"
* [[2000 Florida State Championship Gabriel Alonso FL States HDADTJ Focus on dueling V1 1]] ([[Gabriel Alonso]], [[Dark]]) — "My FL state championship dark deck"; no result given
